title: Amazon Aggregators: Buying Third-Party Sellers - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 35]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: I’m Jesse Pujji and this is Business Breakdowns.
reader_summary.overview: I’m Jesse Pujji and this is Business Breakdowns. Today we are doing a different kind of breakdown. We are covering an entire category, Amazon Aggregators. These are the companies that are buying up hundreds of Amazon’s third-party sellers.

key_points.text: The concept of Amazon Aggregators is relatively new, tracing back to 2018 with the founding of Thrasio.
Most recent numbers peg it at around $300bn dollars in revenue and growing faster than Amazon itself.
These aggregators have unique moats and high-quality entrepreneurs.
